ideas.title: Minnesota DHS Whistleblower Retaliation
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of wrongdoing and retaliation against a Minnesota DHS whistleblower.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential fraud within Minnesota DHS.
questions: What was the nature of the fraud concerns reported?
How did the whistleblower face retaliation?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover deeper issues within Minnesota DHS and potential mismanagement of funds.

ideas.title: $10B Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the halted $10B child care funding freeze and its impact on low-income families.
ideas.angle: Analyze the decision-making process behind the freeze and its halt.
questions: What were the reasons for the freeze?
How will the halt impact low-income families?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal issues with federal funding management and its effects on vulnerable populations.
